title: Interview Guide – European Robotic Surgery Market
objective: Understand hospital adoption, barriers, economics, and purchasing behaviour for robotic surgery systems in Europe.

questions.text: How would you describe current adoption of robotic surgery in your market?
What are the main barriers to adoption?
How important are hospital budgets and ROI in purchasing decisions?
How important are surgeon training and clinical outcomes?
What adoption trend do you expect over the next 3–5 years?
What is the typical hospital decision-making timeline for purchasing a new robotic system?

example_questions: How do experts view the role of economics in robotic surgery purchasing?
Do the experts disagree about adoption growth?
Which expert discusses training capacity as a barrier?
What are the typical purchasing timelines?
How does the UK differ from France and Germany?
